detail.matchHint: Pick the right entry from TMDB. Posters and details update right away.
detail.noMatches: No results. Try a shorter title.
detail.unmatchedHint: Marquee could not find this one on TMDB, so it shows the file name. Fix the match to get artwork and details.
detail.noEpisodes: No episodes in this season yet.
detail.notFoundBody: It may have been removed from its chat. Head back to the library.

browse.emptyBody: Choose which chats to index and tag them, then your library fills in on its own.
browse.noMatchBody: Try another genre or clear the filter.

live.title: Live TV
live.noneBody: Post an M3U playlist or a stream link in a chat tagged Live TV and channels appear here.
live.noMatchBody: Try another category or a different name.
live.noFavBody: Tap the heart on a channel to keep it close.

search.noResultsBody: Check the spelling or try a shorter title.
search.startBody: Results show up as you type.

myList.title: My List
myList.emptyBody: Add a title from anywhere and it will wait for you here.

player.errorTitle: This one won't play right now
player.errorBody: Telegram or the stream did not respond. Give it a moment and try again.
player.errorUnavailable: Telegram is not connected, so this file can't be streamed.
player.externalBody: This phone can’t play this file format inside Marquee. Open it in VLC or another video player.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Changes the whole interface, plus titles, descriptions, posters and logos.
settings.audioLangHint: Which track to start with when a file has several. Independent of the interface language.
settings.subLangHint: Auto shows subtitles only when the audio is not in your interface language.
settings.qualityHint: Used when a title has more than one release.
settings.autoplayNextHint: A countdown appears near the end of an episode.
settings.heroPreview: Play previews on the home screen
settings.heroPreviewHint: A muted trailer fades in behind the featured title.
settings.skipIntroHint: Only works on files with chapters.
settings.sourcesHint: Chats Marquee reads from, and how each is tagged.
settings.rescanHint: Reads every selected chat from the beginning. New messages are picked up on their own.
settings.disconnectHint: Signs out and removes the saved session. Your library stays.
settings.streamCacheHint: Recently watched parts of files, so seeking back is instant.
settings.profilesHint: Add or edit profiles. Each one keeps its own list, history and favourite channels.
settings.tmdbKeyHint: Adds posters, descriptions and artwork in every language. Get a free key at themoviedb.org, under Settings, API.
settings.tmdbInvalid: TMDB rejected that key. Copy it again.

profiles.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Their list and history go too.
profiles.lastOne: You need at least one profile
profiles.maxReached: You can have up to 6 profiles
profiles.manageHint: Everyone gets their own list, history and favourite channels.

status.floodWait: Telegram asked us to slow down. Back in {{seconds}}s.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: That didn't load. Check that the server is running, then try again.
error.offlineBody: The server isn't answering. Start it with npm run dev and reload.

auth.phone_invalid: That phone number doesn't look right.
auth.code_invalid: That code isn't right. Check the digits and try again.
auth.code_expired: That code expired. Request a new one.
auth.credentials_invalid: Telegram rejected those keys. Copy them again from my.telegram.org.
auth.flood: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
auth.no_account: That number has no Telegram account.
auth.network: Couldn't reach Telegram. Check your connection.

onboarding.taglineBody: Marquee reads the groups and channels you pick and turns what's in them into movies, series and live channels.
onboarding.credBody: Telegram needs an API ID and hash for any app that signs in. Create them once at my.telegram.org under API development tools.
onboarding.phoneBody: Use the number your Telegram account is registered with.
onboarding.qrBody: On your phone open Telegram, then Settings, Devices, Link Desktop Device, and scan this code.
onboarding.codeViaApp: Telegram sent a code to your other signed-in device.
onboarding.codeViaSms: Telegram sent the code by SMS.
onboarding.passwordBody: This account has a cloud password.
onboarding.demoNote: Demo mode. Any number works, the code is 12345 and the two-step password is demo (use a number ending in 9).
onboarding.chooseBody: Tag each chat you want in the library. Leave the rest on Skip.
onboarding.noChats: No groups or channels found on this account.
onboarding.indexBody: You can start browsing while it works. New messages are picked up automatically.
onboarding.noTmdb: No TMDB key yet, so titles show file names without posters or descriptions. Add one here or later in Settings.
